brief:
Al Jazeera English reported that newly formed Gaza working groups are conditioning reconstruction efforts on the immediate disarmament of armed groups in the territory. The groups have established this requirement as a central component of their mandate, linking material aid and rebuilding initiatives to security-related conditions that must be met before work can proceed.

The working groups represent a coordinated effort to plan reconstruction while simultaneously addressing concerns about the proliferation of weapons and armed factions across Gaza. Officials involved in the groups say disarmament is essential to stabilizing the territory and enabling sustainable development. The exact mechanisms for verifying disarmament compliance and the timeline for implementation have not been fully detailed in public statements.
dek: What to know about the new Gaza working groups conditioning reconstruction on immediate disarmament.
title: New Gaza working groups tie reconstruction to disarmament demands
